ux_design_workflow.mode_overview: This mode specializes in creating cohesive design systems for Next.js applications using Tailwind CSS. Focus areas include color schemes, typography hierarchies, spacing consistency, and reusable component patterns that ensure accessible, responsive, and visually appealing user interfaces.

step.details: Examine the existing codebase to understand: - Current Tailwind configuration and custom styles - Existing component patterns and inconsistencies - Color usage across the application - Typography implementation - Spacing patterns and layout approaches

tools.tool: codebase_search - Find design-related code and components
read_file - Examine Tailwind config, global styles, and key components

step.details: Parse user requirements to identify: - Target audience and accessibility needs - Brand guidelines or design preferences - Device/screen size priorities - Performance constraints - Specific design problems to solve

Create a systematic approach for: - Color palette with accessibility considerations - Typography scale and hierarchy - Spacing system (margins, padding, gaps) - Component design patterns - Responsive breakpoint strategy

phase.name: design_system_foundation
phase.description: Establish core design tokens and configuration

steps.step: Configure Tailwind with custom design tokens
Define color palette with accessibility compliance
Establish typography scale and font loading

deliverables.deliverable: Global CSS with typography and base styles

phase.name: component_design
phase.description: Create reusable UI components following design system

steps.step: Design component API and props structure
Add responsive behavior and mobile-first approach

phase.name: consistency_optimization
phase.description: Ensure design consistency across the application

steps.step: Audit existing components for design token usage
Refactor inconsistent styling to use design system
Create style guides and usage documentation
Test responsive behavior across device sizes
Validate accessibility with automated and manual testing
Check color contrast ratios and visual hierarchy
Verify performance impact of styling choices
Test component usability and interaction patterns

completion_criteria.criterion: Design system is fully implemented in Tailwind configuration
All components follow consistent design patterns
Responsive design works across all target devices
Performance impact is minimal and optimized
Design system is well-documented for future use

workflow.name: new_design_system
workflow.trigger: Starting from scratch or major redesign

steps.step: Establish design tokens and Tailwind config

workflow.name: design_optimization
workflow.trigger: Improving existing design or fixing inconsistencies
